IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair stands in a full-length pose against a pale
studio backdrop. She wears a gray sleeveless
mock-neck cable-knit top with a diamond cable
pattern and a cropped halter back, paired with a
short gray wool mini skirt. Tall dark gray suede
boots with plush fur trim and buckle straps
complete the look. Her expression is calm and
direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of heathered
gray, charcoal, and cream. Sleek and cozy, in the
style of a minimalist winter catalog.
